== Attacks ==
* <sm2>Dark Willow projectile launch.mp3</sm2> '''Projectile launch''' sound plays as the attack projectile is released.

* <sm2>Dark Willow projectile impact.mp3</sm2> '''Projectile impact''' sound plays as the attack projectile successfully hits the target. (50% vol)

== Movement ==
* <sm2>Dark Willow idle loop.mp3</sm2> Idle sound plays permanently on Dark Willow, gets louder while moving (30% vol).
* <sm2>Dark Willow idle loop extended.mp3</sm2> Extended for better capturing.

== Abilities ==
=== Bramble Maze ===
* <sm2>Bramble Maze cast.mp3</sm2> Cast sound plays on Dark Willow upon cast.
* <sm2>Bramble Maze target area.mp3</sm2> Area sound plays at the targeted area upon cast (70% vol).
* <sm2>Bramble Maze spawn.mp3</sm2> Spawn sound plays on each bramble upon appearing (80% vol).
* Loop sounds play on each bramble upon spawning and until disappearing
** <sm2>Bramble Maze loop 1.mp3</sm2> Loop 1
** <sm2>Bramble Maze loop 2.mp3</sm2> Loop 2
** <sm2>Bramble Maze loop 3.mp3</sm2> Loop 3
** <sm2>Bramble Maze loop 4.mp3</sm2> Loop 4
* <sm2>Bramble Maze expire.mp3</sm2> Expire sound plays on each individual bramble upon disppearing in any way (80% vol).
* <sm2>Bramble Maze proc.mp3</sm2> Proc sound plays on the enemy upon getting rooted.
* Proc layer sounds play on brambles upon rooting an enemy.
** <sm2>Bramble Maze proc layer 1.mp3</sm2> Proc layer 1
** <sm2>Bramble Maze proc layer 2.mp3</sm2> Proc layer 2
** <sm2>Bramble Maze proc layer 3.mp3</sm2> Proc layer 3
** <sm2>Bramble Maze proc layer 4.mp3</sm2> Proc layer 4
* <sm2>Bramble Maze.mp3</sm2> Full sound example.
* <sm2>Bramble Maze target.mp3</sm2> Full sound example of root.

=== Shadow Realm ===
* <sm2>Shadow Realm.mp3</sm2> Cast sound plays on Dark Willow upon cast.
* <sm2>Shadow Realm projectile launch.mp3</sm2> Projectile launch sound plays when the damage is fully charged. Plays on Dark Willow together with the default launch sound.
* <sm2>Shadow Realm projectile impact.mp3</sm2> Projectile impact sound plays on the attack target together with the default impact sound. Always plays, regardless of how much was charged.
* <sm2>Shadow Realm attack.mp3</sm2> Full attack sound example.

=== Cursed Crown ===
* <sm2>Cursed Crown cast.mp3</sm2> Cast sound plays on Dark Willow upon cast (80% vol).
* <sm2>Cursed Crown target.mp3</sm2> Target sound plays on the target upon cast.
* <sm2>Cursed Crown counter.mp3</sm2> Counter sound plays on the target every second, starting one second after cast, for 3 seconds (+50% pitch).
* <sm2>Cursed Crown stun.mp3</sm2> Stun sound plays on the target as the debuff expires.
* <sm2>Cursed Crown.mp3</sm2> Full sound example.

=== Bedlam ===
* <sm2>Bedlam.mp3</sm2> Cast sound plays on Dark Willow upon cast.
* <sm2>Bedlam attack.mp3</sm2> Attack sound plays on Jex whenever he launches a projectile.

=== Terrorize ===
* <sm2>Terrorize cast.mp3</sm2> Cast sound plays on Dark Willow upon cast.
* <sm2>Terrorize projectile.mp3</sm2> Projectile sound plays on Jex upon cast and follows him.
* <sm2>Terrorize target area.mp3</sm2> Area sound plays at the targeted area upon cast.
* <sm2>Terrorize target.mp3</sm2> Target sound plays on each hit enemy upon placing the debuff.
* <sm2>Terrorize.mp3</sm2> Full sound example.
